title: Avomi CLIQ Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill - Peach Ice
description: Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pods pair with the Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod Kit for simple, consistent MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container for extended use from the same flavour. A mesh coil promotes clean flavour and steady vapour, while the push-to-refill design makes topping up quick and tidy — connect pod to refill and attach both to your Cliq device. Expect up to around 6000 puffs per pack depending on how you vape, with 20mg Nicotine Salt for a smooth inhale. Peach Ice serves soft, ripe Peach with a cool exhale, giving a light fruit-and-ice mix that tastes fresh and easy-going. Once your pod and refill is empty, simply swap them out for a fresh Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod + Refill pack, View the full range of Avomi Cliq Prefilled pod kits & Refill Pods
